news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 5 new directors. No experienced directors. 1 highly experienced director. Non-Executive Chairperson of the Board Pradip Ghosh is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2017. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.04 (vs ₹0.033 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.04 (up from ₹0.033 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹1.46m (up 53% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹389.0k (up 17% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 27% (down from 35% in 3Q 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 134% per year but the company’s share price has only increased by 36% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings growth.
